email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Car Checker password
email.password_reset.body:
Hello {first_name},

We received a request to reset your Car Checker password.
Open the link below to choose a new password. It expires in {expires_minutes} minutes.

{reset_url}

If you did not request this, you can ignore this email: your password will not change.

The Car Checker team
email.password_changed.subject: Your Car Checker password was changed
email.password_changed.body:
Hello {first_name},

The password of your Car Checker account was just changed and your other sessions were signed out.
If you did not make this change, reset your password immediately.

The Car Checker team
